item.title: Good Morning Family - 13 June 2026
item.description:
Wake up Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Saturday, the 13 June.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 11 degrees and a top of 16 degrees.
There is about a 100 percent chance of rain.
You might need a raincoat today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is H.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter H?
. . . . . . . . . . . .
